answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 156533 Country: INDIA Title: Do I need to take bath after removing public hair? Question: Do I need to take a bath after removing public hair? Can I perform namaz without taking bath after removing public hair? Answer ID: 156533 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 338/290/H=2/1439) (1) It is not mandatory. (2) It is valid to offer salah without taking a bath and there is no karahat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
